LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainPump.label: hemogel drain pump
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainPump.description: Draws hemogel from the colony network and collects it in canisters. Requires electricity and flesh cover beneath it. Can be captured and reinstalled.
LanguageData.FB_HemogelCanister.label: hemogel canister
LanguageData.FB_HemogelCanister.description: A sealed drum of hemogel siphoned from the colony. Its contents can be returned to the network or stored separately, safe from further siphoning.
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainPumpIncoming.label: drain pump (incoming)
LanguageData.FB_NeuronSuppressor.label: neural suppressor
LanguageData.FB_NeuronSuppressor.description: An emitter that blocks grasping and cargo tendrils within its radius. Protects people and supplies from capture by the flesh while powered.
LanguageData.FB_NeuronSuppressorIncoming.label: neural suppressor (incoming)
LanguageData.FB_FleshDrainBatteryIncoming.label: battery (incoming)
